profile.headline: Software Engineer, Marketplace at Zipline

positions.title: Senior Staff Engineer, Borrow
positions.description:
Technical leader across multiple pods that support SoFi’s lending business, including:
•	Hands-on architecting and building loan platform systems
•	Working with internal stakeholders to define product direction
•	Evaluating and integrating with third-party offerings and data sources 
•	Mentoring engineers and engineering managers
•	Building particular domain expertise in debt collections and recovery operations

positions.title: Engineering Manager, New Verticals Inventory and Integrations
positions.description:
Leading engineering teams to:
•	Increase selection for consumers of DoorDash's growing non-restaurant verticals (groceries, convenience, alcohol, retail) both by expanding item coverage and by increasing the number of merchants on the platform
•	Ingest and process real-time merchant inventory, pricing and catalog data through direct integrations (APIs, batch feed files) and indirectly (POS integrations, scraping, merchant tooling)
•	Build and maintain a source of truth for merchant inventory and catalog data
•	Influence consumer affordability by ingesting and controlling item prices, fee structures, promotions, deals, CPG ads, SNAP/EBT payments, etc.

positions.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Ads Serving, Ads and Personalization
positions.description:
•	Launched a full-featured, first-party ad server consisting of microservices and data pipelines, capable of targeting, ranking and serving personalized content to support Grab’s growing ads business
•	Led backend and frontend engineers, both direct reports and sub-teams, in Seattle and Beijing
•	Supported career growth of engineers, including multiple promotions as well as role transitions from
frontend to backend and IC to manager
•	Grew the team from 5 engineers to 15

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, Transportation
positions.description:
•	Contributed to the design and implementation of distributed systems in Grab’s bookings platform, including launching a high-scale, low-latency source of truth for all of Grab’s booking data.
•	Continued to iterate on ridesharing products, including microservices and algorithms capable of batching multiple rides/orders together for fulfillment by a single driver.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer, Transportation
positions.description:
•	Worked on the high-scale backend services, simulations and algorithms behind Grab's ride sharing product, GrabShare.
•	Launched GrabBus as part of a 3-person dev team; a product supporting purchasing and redeeming third party bus tickets. This allowed bus operators to sell tickets on Grab's platform, with Grab handling sales, inventory management and payments.
•	Worked primarily in Golang
•	Promoted to Principal Software Engineer

positions.title: Software Engineer, Azure Capacity Optimization
positions.description:
•	Designed and built microservices and SDKs for managing capacity allocation and optimization for
Microsoft Azure, using C#/.NET and Microsoft Azure web services. This includes backend work to guarantee capacity for Azure Reserved VM Instances.
•	Selected for two consecutive years to participate in the LabOne program; Microsoft’s leadership development program for high potential employees (HiPo, previously
known as BENCH/Lab365).
•	Promoted to level 62.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer, Supply Chain
positions.description:
•	Developed and maintained scalable, highly-available web services for data driven prediction of vendor behavior using JAVA and C++, driving parameters for automated inventory purchasing. Involved in all facets of the development life cycle including initial design, implementation, testing, deployment and support
•	Led team's project planning and tracking as Scrum Master
•	Contributed to technical recruiting by conducting phone and on-site technical interviews, attending college campus career fairs, and proctoring group coding exercises
•	Promoted to SDE II

positions.title: Undergraduate Capstone Open Source Project (UCOSP) student
positions.description:
•	Worked on a team to add Ingres support to the GeoTools open source GIS package.
•	Gained significant experience working remotely as well as contributing to open source software.

company.name: Centre for Molecular Medicine and Therapeutics

positions.title: Bioinformatics Project Assistant
positions.description:
•	Created OWL Ontology to store transcription factor classification data including a software package used to manipulate this ontology
•	Created database exporter using Perl to extract transcription factor and regulatory sequence data from the PAZAR relational database and parse this data as an XML document
•	Published as an author in Nucleic Acids Research scientific journal article as a result of my work with the PAZAR database

positions.title: Bioinformatics Intern
positions.description:
•	Implemented a novel bioinformatics algorithm in JAVA and integrated it into the ANNOTATOR software environment
•	Sponsored by the A*STAR Singapore International Pre-Graduate Award (given to top overseas students to conduct fully funded research in Singapore)
•	Worked with world-renowned scientists at Singapore’s most prestigious research institution

company.name: Singapore Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR); Bioinformatics Institute

positions.title: System Integration & Test Specialist (co-op)
positions.description:
•	Thoroughly tested the interaction between RIM software and third party mobile devices running Windows Mobile and Symbian operating systems
•	Designed test cases and created approved test case documents
•	Designed Visual Basic Scripts to import test cases into an automated software quality assurance testing system (Mercury Quality Center).  Created significant improvement over previous method of storing test results and allowed easier assigning to team members
•	Organized and set up automated Java Conformance Testing system to test RIM compliance to JSRs supported by the BlackBerry Application Suite (BAS).  Was first system to be implemented at Ottawa campus. Involved me communicating and collaborating with a number of teams in both Ottawa and Waterloo
•	Received excellent review from team manager and direct supervisor

honors.title: NSERC Alexander Graham Bell Canada Graduate Scholarship (CGS) M
